scope: Independent source-only review of hosted-release repair 45cc5f06c8df53191a1468f5dbebfe0f603f31ec; no local install, build, test, browser, or hosted rerun

verdictA.reason: The release source preserves the strict checks and validates a candidate before atomic main/tag publication. A successful hosted candidate and native exact-package guest/member acceptance remain unobserved.

verdictB.reason: Both prior Important source findings are addressed. The dependency guard fails closed before every generation/check/build attempt when the merged candidate changes tracked pnpm inputs. A failed mandatory check writes a restricted diagnostic file, and the workflow uploads it independently of the success-only validated ZIP/receipt artifact. Runtime confirmation and a dependency-changing race regression are still needed.

priorFindings.evidence: release.sh writes gate, exit code and candidate on strict-check failure; PIN, STALE and DUPLICATE package failures also yield parsed package/version fields. release.yml uploads diagnostics.txt on failure with a run-unique artifact name while validated artifacts remain default success-only. The parsed line patterns match the package gate source.

Each release loop assembles BASE_TREE and immediately compares package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml, .npmrc, .pnpmfile.cjs and patches with LOCAL_HEAD, the checkout installed and refreshed by the hosted workflow. A difference exits before snapshots, regeneration, checks, build or push, including on a push-race retry. Current tracked dependency inputs are package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and .npmrc.

newFindings.title: Ahead-of-registry package failures lose the package detail in the sanitized artifact
newFindings.evidence: scripts/check-matrx-packages.mjs emits AHEAD: lines for installed versions newer than npm latest. release.sh's diagnostic parser accepts only PIN, STALE and DUPLICATE, leaving just gate/exit/candidate in diagnostics.txt for this case.
newFindings.action: Add AHEAD to the allowlisted parser and prove the expected sanitized output. This is not a release-safety bypass.

newFindings.title: Dependency-changing remote race has no forcing regression
newFindings.evidence: scripts/test-release-ship-path.sh exercises remote text-file races with stubbed pnpm, but does not change a dependency input and assert fail-closed behavior. No hosted rerun of 45cc5f06 was available in this lane.
newFindings.action: Exercise a dependency-input change on remote main and verify no candidate ZIP, tag or main publication follows; inspect the hosted failure artifact.

limits: Read release.sh, release.yml, package gate, existing fixture and tracked input inventory; bash syntax check passed. No runtime release evidence was created.
The current shared checkout contains unrelated in-progress edits; this report alone was staged and committed.
No claim of hosted green release, native guest/member acceptance, signout privacy, Chrome Web Store submission or deployment.
